views.markdown:
Adds a Samsung OneUI-style app drawer to iOS. Swipe up from the dock or home screen to reveal all your apps in a clean, searchable grid.

**Features:**
- Swipe up from dock to open
- Search apps in real-time
- Clean grid layout with app icons and names
- Smooth spring animations
- Works on iOS 15.0+

**Requirements:**
- iOS 15.0 or later
- Jailbroken device with Sileo/Zebra/Installer

## 1.0.0
- Initial release
- OneUI-style app drawer
- Real-time search
- Spring animations
- iOS 15+ support
